svg.text: Dynamic — animated while the cache is warm

g.text: aurora · light — a gleam sweeps a thin line of light as the cache drains
pulse · electric — a live waveform that runs, flattens near expiry, flatlines cold
glass · glass — beads of light that empty in quarter steps, a breathing diamond
flux · futuristic — a spark glides along a track, racing as the cache runs out
prism · light refracting — a bright band travels through a glass bar
classic · traffic-light dots and every number
bars · mini gauges — read time left and use at a glance
icons · icons and numbers — short and friendly
minimal · words only — color appears only when something needs you
blueprint · thin line gauges, perfectly still — the calm twin of aurora
